name: Quarkcode NeuralCommerce Lite – Profit Analytics & Cost Intelligence Hub
author: vortexplaytv

sections.description:
Quarkcode NeuralCommerce Lite transforms your WooCommerce store into a data-driven powerhouse. Stop guessing your profits and start knowing exactly how much you make on every order, product, and customer.

This plugin goes beyond simple revenue tracking by integrating Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), shipping costs, payment gateway fees, and custom overheads to give you the true Net Profit picture. It leverages AI to provide predictive insights, helping you optimize pricing, manage inventory, and maximize margins.

🚀 Key Features

  • 📊 Advanced Profit Analytics Dashboard

    • Real-time visibility into Net Profit, Margins, and ROI.
    • Track profitability by Order, Product, Category, and Customer.
    • Visualize trends with dynamic charts and heatmaps.

  • 💰 Precise Cost of Goods (COGS) Management

    • Easily add COGS to simple and variable products.
    • Bulk Edit costs via CSV import or percentage-based updates.
    • Custom Cost Rules: Add extra costs for packaging, labor, and warehousing.
    • Track historical cost changes over time.

  • ⚠️ Automated Margin Alerts

    • Get notified immediately when margins drop below your threshold.
    • Unprofitable Order Alerts: Catch money-losing orders instantly.
    • Cost Increase Alerts: Monitor supplier price hikes.
    • Daily Profit Summaries: Wake up to a morning digest of your store’s performance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/quarkcode-neuralcommerce-lite directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to NeuralCommerce in the admin dashboard.
  4. Go to Product Costs to start entering your COGS data.
  5. Enjoy real-time profit tracking!
